clue.text: Relieved husband gets in plenty of petrol

clue.text: Involuntary movement of countryman towards town, we hear

explanation.definitionFit: A hiccup is a spasm of the diaphragm, a reflex jerk the body makes without intent.

explanation.definitionFit: Entitling is naming, so a set of rules for naming things is a scheme of terms.
